# Pending outcomes

The following outcomes appear inline with their readiness reason.  They are
not hidden in an appendix and no current aggregate field is substituted.

| Outcome | Status | Readiness reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Weekly time under treatment | Blocked | The future schema must distinguish planned no-treatment, treatment, and death in mutually exclusive weekly states, with interval completeness. |
| Time to next treatment line | Blocked | Treatment-line records lack an approved transition reason, line-change rule, and censoring/completeness fields. |
| Time to switch/stop | Blocked | The current optional switch/stop dates do not define event type, reason, competing death, or complete observation. |
| Targeted therapy | Blocked | A targeted-therapy flag lacks the qualifying agent/class, alteration linkage, exposure dates, and observation rule. |
| Trial referral/recruitment | Blocked | Referral, offer, acceptance, recruitment, and enrolment are separate steps without approved denominators and dates. |
| Physical function | Blocked | No instrument/version, score direction, schedule, or death-inclusive estimand is approved. |

The exact required fields are documented in the non-executing contracts under
`analysis/90-pending/`.  Once those schemas are approved, each contract can
produce a status manifest before any model is considered.
